responsibilities.name: Continuous Repo Improvement
responsibilities.instruction: Run one full repo improvement cycle: audit the agent codebase against PRODUCT_CANON.md and BRAIN_CANON.md for efficiency, structure, logic, and cleanness improvements; propose the single highest-value change; on approval, delegate implementation to engineering and verify the result.

context.purpose: Systematic, canon-compliant improvement of the Architect Prime codebase. Each cycle audits one focus area, proposes one improvement ranked by the BRAIN_CANON rubric, and delegates implementation to an engineer agent.
process: STEP 1 — CANON RE-READ: Read PRODUCT_CANON.md and BRAIN_CANON.md to refresh invariants and quality axes.
STEP 2 — GATHER CONTEXT: Read prior_learnings from this responsibility. Recall relevant Core Memory entries.
STEP 3 — AUDIT: Inspect the current focus_area using the repo-audit skill. Read files, check patterns, identify improvement opportunities.
STEP 4 — RANK: Score each finding against the BRAIN_CANON Part IV rubric. Select the single highest-value improvement.
STEP 5 — PROPOSE: Create a structured proposal document with scope globs, before/after description, rubric claim, acceptance criteria, and risk notes.
STEP 6 — APPROVAL GATE: Submit the proposal for operator approval before delegating.
STEP 7 — DELEGATE: Send the delegation to an engineer agent via the GChat Delegation Protocol with scope globs, acceptance criteria, and process reference.
STEP 8 — REVIEW: Verify delegation results against both canons. Accept or reject.
STEP 9 — LEARN: Write learnings to Core Memory and update this responsibility's prior_learnings.
context.success_criteria: One improvement proposed, ranked by rubric, delegated to engineering, results verified against both canons, learnings recorded.
